# tasks.org and jtx Board through DAVx5 writing back: a completion, an
# un-completion, an edit, a create and a delete. Written from published
# client behaviour, not captured traffic: DAVx5 uploads each changed task
# with If-Match, or If-None-Match: * for a new one, as ical4j writes it:
# STATUS, COMPLETED and PERCENT-COMPLETE together on a tick, the task's own
# time zone on DUE and DTSTART, and RELATED-TO for a subtask. It downloads
# the object again after a PUT answered without an ETag.

### the tags tix shows are set in the browser
DO tag open1

### the ETags at depth 1
PROPFIND {assigned}
Depth: 1

<propfind xmlns="DAV:"><prop><getetag/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 207
SAVE etag1 {assigned}{open1}.ics {DAV:}getetag

### tasks.org ticks the task
PUT {assigned}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: {etag1}

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:+//IDN bitfire.at//ical4android (org.tasks)
BEGIN:VTODO
DTSTAMP:20260101T090000Z
UID:task-{open1}@tix
SEQUENCE:3
CREATED:20260101T000000Z
LAST-MODIFIED:20260101T090000Z
SUMMARY:Rotate keys
PRIORITY:0
STATUS:COMPLETED
COMPLETED:20260101T090000Z
PERCENT-COMPLETE:100
CATEGORIES:ops,security
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 204
TASK open1 status done

### downloaded again
GET {assigned}{open1}.ics

EXPECT 200
HAS STATUS:COMPLETED
SAVEHEADER etag2 ETag

### tasks.org unticks it
PUT {assigned}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: {etag2}

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:+//IDN bitfire.at//ical4android (org.tasks)
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:task-{open1}@tix
SUMMARY:Rotate keys
PRIORITY:0
STATUS:NEEDS-ACTION
CATEGORIES:ops,security
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 204
TASK open1 status todo

### downloaded again
GET {assigned}{open1}.ics

EXPECT 200
SAVEHEADER etag3 ETag

### a due time in the phone's zone, a hide-until start and a new tag
PUT {assigned}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: {etag3}

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:+//IDN bitfire.at//ical4android (org.tasks)
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:task-{open1}@tix
SUMMARY:Rotate keys
PRIORITY:9
STATUS:NEEDS-ACTION
DTSTART;TZID=Europe/Sofia:20260110T090000
DUE;TZID=Europe/Sofia:20260112T180000
CATEGORIES:ops,security,phone
X-APPLE-SORT-ORDER:0
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 204
TASK open1 due 2026-01-12T16:00Z
TASK open1 snoozed 2026-01-10T07:00Z
TASK open1 tags ops,phone,security

### a subtask created in tasks.org, assigned to its owner
PUT {assigned}5b1e1d0c-3f2a-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-None-Match: *

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:+//IDN bitfire.at//ical4android (org.tasks)
BEGIN:VTODO
DTSTAMP:20260101T100000Z
UID:5b1e1d0c-3f2a-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
CREATED:20260101T100000Z
SUMMARY:Order a token
PRIORITY:5
RELATED-TO;RELTYPE=PARENT:task-{open1}@tix
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 403
HAS project's list

### the same subtask in the Infra list
PUT {infra}5b1e1d0c-3f2a-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-None-Match: *

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:+//IDN bitfire.at//ical4android (org.tasks)
BEGIN:VTODO
DTSTAMP:20260101T100000Z
UID:5b1e1d0c-3f2a-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
CREATED:20260101T100000Z
SUMMARY:Order a token
PRIORITY:5
RELATED-TO;RELTYPE=PARENT:task-{open1}@tix
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 201
TASK Order_a_token status todo

### the subtask downloaded keeps its UID and drops RELATED-TO
GET {infra}5b1e1d0c-3f2a-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d.ics

EXPECT 200
HAS UID:5b1e1d0c-3f2a-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
LACKS RELATED-TO

### deleting a task in tasks.org
DELETE {assigned}{open2}.ics

EXPECT 204
TASK open2 status cancelled
TASK open2 trashed false
